messages:
maya: Quick idea  make the webinar landing page modular so attendees pick a track (dev vs infra) at signup. lowers churn in labs. thoughts?
raj: good. then tailor the first 2 slides for each track (bench + cost for infra, hands-on config for dev).
claire: localized abstracts needed for ES and PT markets. can do short + long versions. also propose a translated 30s social clip.
zoe: ops: fine, but track selection must map to HubSpot field 'webinar_track'. registrants -> list 'track_modular_2026'. hot leads flow unchanged. ops-bot: automation will create hs_field and list when landing page goes live.
sam: demo impact: if people split into labs, we need two parallel lab guides and two helper hosts. can recruit 1 eng for infra lab.
maya: run-of-show (50m): 1m intro, 6m bench headline (split slides), 10m customer story A, 12m demo (branching content), 12m simultaneous labs (opt-in), 9m wrap + CTAs.
raj: CTA ideas: 1) trial-with-lab-credit, 2) benchmark repo link, 3) office-hours sign-up. recommend UTM per CTA.
claire: speaker kit addendum: local language 1-liners + suggested tweets. will deliver by Fri.
zoe: post-event routing: registrants -> 'track_modular_2026' list; attended + lab_joined -> SDR task + tag 'lab-engaged'. ops-bot: queued.
maya: fallback: if live labs misbehave, convert labs to guided walkthroughs with recorded clips and keep open breakout rooms.
sam: volunteer hosts: Sam (demo), Raj (bench narrative), Maya (Q&A). I will prepare lab helper checklist.
ops-bot: reminder set: submit localized clips by Thu 18:00 PT; rehearsal Sat 10:00 PT; webinar Mon 11:00 PT.
maya: perfect. small ask  can someone QA the registration funnel (track mapping -> hubspot) today?
zoe: I'll run QA and report back in this thread. :thumbsup:
